psychological_meaning: Congress Blue evokes feelings of trust, stability, and authority. It is often associated with intelligence, confidence, and efficiency. The color can also represent loyalty, peace, and success, making it a popular choice for organizations seeking to convey a sense of reliability and professionalism.

real_world_examples.title: U.S. Congress Seal
real_world_examples.description: The U.S. Congress seal features a prominent shade of blue, symbolizing authority and integrity.

real_world_examples.title: Corporate Branding
real_world_examples.description: Many corporations use Congress Blue in their logos and branding materials to convey a sense of professionalism and trust.

how_to_pair: Pair with neutrals like gray and white for a professional look.
Use with lighter blues for a calming and serene palette.
Combine with yellow for a contrasting and energetic feel.
